rows.notable_exceptions: Incremental nursing needs physician order/documentation; home DME needs discharge documentation; convenience private rooms excluded.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: General hospital facility reimbursement bundles routine room-and-board, nursing, supplies, equipment, and many ancillary services into the facility payment. Separate reimbursement is limited to specific exceptions such as physician-ordered incremental nursing, certain discharge DME, and infusion or injection administration when that service is the primary reason for the visit.

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: Bundle facility-claim ancillary services 96360-96379, 96401, 96402, 96409-96425, 96521-96523, 36400, 36405, 36406, 36410, and 36415 when they appear on the same facility claim with primary service in facility POS, including revenue codes 0230-0239, 0278, 020X, and 017X; do not apply the edit when modifier TC is present; require physician order, and preserve the stated exceptions for infusion or injection primary service and medical isolation private room. Exempt: infusion or injection primary service, medical isolation private room.
